system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. original_prompt: Create a Kubernetes Ingress manifest routing traffic from 'app.example.com' to a Service 'frontend-svc' on port 80, terminating TLS using a Secret named 'app-tls-cert'.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Kubernetes manifest (YAML)

Task: Create a Kubernetes Ingress manifest routing traffic from 'app.example.com' to a Service 'frontend-svc' on port 80, terminating TLS using a Secret named 'app-tls-cert'.

Output only the Kubernetes manifest (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: frontend-ingress
  namespace: default
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: frontend
    app.kubernetes.io/component: ingress
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: kubernetes
  annotations:
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/ssl-redirect: "true"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/force-ssl-redirect: "true"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/backend-protocol: "HTTP"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-body-size: "8m"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-read-timeout: "60"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-send-timeout: "60"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/ssl-protocols: "TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3"
spec:
  ingressClassName: nginx
  tls:
    - hosts:
        - app.example.com
      secretName: app-tls-cert
  rules:
    - host: app.example.com
      http:
        paths:
          - path: /
            pathType: Prefix
            backend:
              service:
                name: frontend-svc
                port:
                  number: 80
